purpose: Final separately frozen setup recovery of the four-task QRS control-plane canary. Rebuild a fresh Primitive-H0 bank, exercise the general bounded evidence-inspection interface, retain a legal complete-information ABSTAIN without converting it into a Review failure, and condition any candidate path on mandatory exact-candidate answer-free Review, the complete 12-cell matched panel gate, answer-free handoff, and same-stop zero-work resume. Stop after panel 1. This is not an R2 repeat and no R3 material is reusable by main.

setup_recovery.antecedent_measured_boundary: R2 completed four fresh valid Primitive-H0 cells and built its answer-free panel bank. During its single Evolver proposal, two otherwise valid broad trace_slice calls exceeded the bounded return limit after constructing repeated long-JSONL context windows. The Evolver later recorded a legal ABSTAIN, but the outer controller interpreted the absence of a Review-bound candidate as an invalid panel Review and stopped. Reviewer calls and candidate matched cells were zero.
only_engineering_changes: The general trace_slice interface returns the earliest matches that fit as a partial result with truncated=true and an explicit truncation reason instead of failing after a valid request exceeds the return-byte budget.
The general read_workspace interface caps returned content at 64000 bytes and reports returned_bytes plus truncated while preserving its existing source-file admission boundary.

The general Evolver prompt and tool descriptors direct JSONL inspection to begin with a narrow regular expression, zero context and at most eight matches, then use a one-physical-line read at a returned match_line when needed.
The general Evolver guidance and decision validation define evidence_refs as already-read immutable evidence paths rather than candidate workspace paths.

The outer scheduler retains a legal complete-information ABSTAIN as an explicit panel result, carries the unchanged frozen parent and answer-free accepted history, dispatches no Review or candidate Worker for that panel, and does not misclassify the outcome as a missing Review.
setup_recovery.frozen_scientific_constants: Same four tasks, Primitive-H0 treatment, model, provider, runtime, family and anchor layout, answer boundary, Reviewer policy, matched gate, promotion predicate, caps, concurrency, stop-after-panel boundary, and no-main-reuse rule as R2.
reuse_forbidden: R2 Primitive-H0 Worker executions, conversations, traces, state telemetry, finals, artifacts or process records
R2 trajectory bank, R2 panel evidence tree, R2 access history or R2 evidence read state
R2 proposal, decision, candidate material, claim inventory or discovery artifacts
R2 official scores, R2 verifier material, R2 controller outcomes or R2 scheduler decisions
Any R1 material or any other antecedent canary material

final_recovery_policy.mini_clear_rule: The mini gate clears only after an admitted candidate receives complete overall and coverage Review PASS, the exact reviewed snapshot runs all 12 matched parent-candidate cells, the scheduler materializes the answer-free handoff for the resulting panel decision, and a same-stop resume performs zero new work with identical state and accounting.
final_recovery_policy.main_authority_after_mini_clear: Clearing this engineering mini gate does not reuse R3 material in main and does not itself authorize paid or remote main launch.

public_task_partition_rule.main_experiment_membership: No R1, R2 or R3 canary Worker, candidate, trajectory, claim inventory, evidence access state or decision is reusable by main.

cross_family_workflow_evidence.canary_panel_1_visible_rule: The complete fresh R3 holdings Primitive-H0 trajectory plus one frozen fresh R3 Primitive-H0 anchor from derivatives and rates. No R1 or R2 material, score, verifier output, controller outcome, proposal, evidence access state, prior candidate or sealed identity enters Evolver evidence.

phase1_six_panel_curriculum.promotion_rule: The same focus-plus-other-family-anchor repeated task-reward gate as R2 and main. A scientific non-promotion after the complete matched path is valid and still exercises the handoff and carry path; integrity, protocol, accounting or boundary failures stop the canary.

required_live_outcomes.review_pass: An admitted candidate must receive overall PASS and coverage PASS from the mandatory answer-free Candidate Information-Set Review and must be copied to the exact reviewed snapshot before any candidate Worker dispatch.
required_live_outcomes.matched_gate: After Review PASS, the exact reviewed candidate and fresh parent must complete all 12 matched cells: three panel-visible tasks, two arms and two fresh repetitions with reversed arm order in repetition 2.
required_live_outcomes.answer_boundary: Review input contains the complete cumulative Primitive-H0-to-candidate Worker-visible material and trusted public contracts only; optimize_only_sources is empty; Review output and official fitness never enter Worker material.
required_live_outcomes.handoff: After the complete matched decision, the scheduler writes the answer-free panel handoff. Promotion appends only candidate answer-free traces and clean accepted claims; scientific non-promotion carries only previously accepted answer-free history and the unchanged parent. No score or Reviewer reasoning enters later evidence.
required_live_outcomes.resume: A same stop_after_panel zero-work resume preserves the exact state, cost, reviewed snapshot, handoff and child results and creates no new action.
required_live_outcomes.terminal: MINI_SCHEDULER_PASS requires the complete Review-PASS, 12-cell matched, handoff and zero-work-resume path. A legal complete-information ABSTAIN is retained as a valid terminal outcome but does not clear the mini gate, leaves Main NO-GO, and authorizes no further setup recovery.

answer_boundary: All four R3 Primitive-H0 Workers and any R3 candidate Workers are blind to scores, verifier output, failed properties, expected values, optimization diagnostics, Review artifacts, R1 material, R2 material and all prior evidence access state.
claim_boundary: This final setup-recovery canary may validate bounded evidence retrieval, legal abstention retention, isolation, structured pre-write declaration, exact Candidate Review, matched dispatch, answer-free handoff, accounting, cleanup and resume. It is not an R2 repeat, main result, benchmark gain, reusable candidate, stable promotion, sealed result or evidence for QRS effectiveness.
